keyVerseDR: "Lord, thou knowest all things: thou knowest that I love thee. He said to him: Feed my sheep." (Jn 21:17)

level1.title: Breakfast With Jesus
level1.story: Peter and his friends fished all night and caught nothing. Jesus told them where to cast the net, and it filled with fish! Jesus asked Peter three times, "Do you love Me?"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you show Jesus you love Him?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You know that I love You. Amen.

activity.title: A big catch

level2.title: Do You Love Me?
level2.story: Peter and other disciples went fishing on the Sea of Tiberias, but that night they caught nothing. In the morning, Jesus stood on the shore and said, "Cast the net on the right side of the ship," and they could hardly pull it in for the fish: one hundred fifty-three! The disciple whom Jesus loved said, "It is the Lord," and Peter jumped into the sea. After breakfast by a charcoal fire, Jesus asked Peter three times, "Lovest thou Me?" Each time Peter said, "Yea, Lord, Thou knowest that I love Thee," and Jesus said, "Feed My sheep."
level2.keyLine: Lord, thou knowest that I love thee. Feed my sheep.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus ask Peter three times?
actions: Tell Jesus I love Him daily
level2.prayer: Jesus, You know that I love You; help me serve. Amen.
